name: Dark Fantasy Choco Fills
ingredients_raw: Choco crème (38.0%) {sugar, refined palmolein, refined palm oil, cocoa solids, emulsifier [lecithin (from soyabean)], nature identical flavouring substances (chocolate), artificial flavouring substances (vanilla)}, maida (refined wheat flour), hydrogenated vegetable oils, sugar, invert syrup, liquid glucose, raising agents [INS 503(ii), INS 500(ii), INS 450(i)], cocoa solids (0.7%), butter, milk solids, iodized salt, nature identical flavouring substances (milk chocolate), colours (INS 150c, INS 150d), emulsifiers [lecithin (from soyabean), mono and diglycerides of fatty acids (from palm oil)], artificial flavouring substances (milk, vanilla).
